messages.subject: Project Mallory — A&R agreement, first draft
messages.plaintextBody:
Olivia,

With the IBR finalised and the standstill holding, here is our first draft of the Amendment and Restatement Agreement. As discussed it provides for: the new £6m super-senior Facility C; a covenant reset stepping from 5.25x (Mar-26) down to 3.50x (Mar-27); a margin uplift of 175bps to 4.25% on Facility A and the RCF (plus 1.50% PIK on Facility A); and an amendment fee of 0.75% (£315,000). Schedule 2 will append the full A&R facilities agreement.

Look forward to your mark-up.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
T +44 (0)20 7946 0021

This email is confidential and may be legally privileged. If you are not the intended recipient please notify the sender and delete it.
